summary: Apple's FSKit lets an app extension run a file system module in user space and mount it. BifrOSt has no user-space file system module API and no volume or item model for apps. Its file access is the document grant broker and file watching, and the Linux kernel supplies the file systems themselves.

features.note: Read-only first version: FUSE protocol 7.31 encode/decode and READDIR packing (fuse.rs), fusermount3 mount and serve loop (fuse_mount.rs), and an app trait with a dispatcher (fs_module.rs). Host tests: fuse::tests (decode, reply sizes, dirent alignment) and fs_module::tests (dispatcher over an in-memory volume fed synthetic requests). Not built or run; no Midget mount. No shell mount service or grant check yet.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 3 (w3-fskit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Files uses shell file utilities. Apps get paths and descriptors, not a volume or item object model.

features.feature: Resources (block device, path URL, generic URL)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs (grants resolve a path beneath the account home and return a descriptor); springboard/ui/src/fs_resource.rs (Resource: block device, path URL, generic URL)
features.note: The resource kinds and their checks are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-complete-23.rs, and the grant model still covers one path per app and per file. Gap: no resource is opened or mounted from a block device node or a generic URL yet.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 3 (w3-fskit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No probe-then-mount step exists for an app or the shell.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/extent_map.rs (ExtentMap::new, ExtentMap::locate); the Linux kernel file systems allocate the extents
features.note: Extent packing, overlap refusal and the file-offset to disk-offset lookup are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-os-02.rs. Gap: the kernel file systems do the allocation, and no call yet reads a real file's extents from the kernel.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Logging exists. FSKit's typed file system error domain has no BifrOSt counterpart.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs (per-request grant ids and cancellation); springboard/ui/src/fs_maintenance.rs (operation ids, task log, completion)
features.note: Operation ids, the per-task message log, finish-once completion with a failure reason and cancellation are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-complete-23.rs. Gap: there are no FSTaskOptions and no completion channel into a file system module, which needs a running module to exist.

features.apple: Used with mounted volumes (no direct FSKit class)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Apple's FSEvents has no direct FSKit class. This row covers the watch side of a mounted volume's changes.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 3 (w3-fskit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No API lets an app or daemon ask for a mount, check or repair. The installer partitions disks (springboard/src/installer/plan.rs), but that is not an app-facing API.
The entitlement is an Apple distribution control with no counterpart. App isolation exists in app_policy.rs.

gaps: No shell mount service or grant check for a user-space file system module (the read-only SDK module and FUSE session exist; write operations do not)
No SDK volume and item model (FSVolume, FSItem) for the Files app or third-party apps
No probe, mount or maintenance request path for apps or daemons (FSClient equivalent)
No FSTask-style channel from a file system module to the shell for log and completion events
Mounted volumes are missing from the file panel sidebar (docs/bifrost-ui.md, file panel section)
